TITLE: Status Report for Project Hamuis

Project Hamuis is currently at a stable phase of execution, with several key milestones having been completed and the team maintaining a strong focus on upcoming deliverables. The project remains aligned with the overall strategic goals of Zastama Industries, and all current operations are proceeding within the outlined scope and timeline.

**Summary**  
Project Hamuis is staffed by 31 people and is operating under budget code BC-2450-Q. The project is supported by Krolpumen Labs under a 36-month master services agreement. The current phase involves the refinement of technical specifications and the coordination of external testing protocols. The team has demonstrated consistent progress, with all internal evaluations indicating satisfactory performance to date.

**Progress**  
Recent weeks have seen significant progress on the core integration modules, with all primary components now aligned and undergoing stress testing. The finance lead has confirmed that all expenditures under budget code noted earlier remain within projected limits, with no overruns reported to date. The project team, including technical leads and external collaborators from Krolpumen Labs, is on schedule to meet the next key deliverable by the end of the quarter.

A dedicated subgroup has also finalized the documentation for the initial deployment phase, and internal reviews have been completed without major revisions. Project Hamuis’s escrow reference YG-2546-M has been updated to reflect the latest version of the software, ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory standards.

**Risks**  
While no critical risks have been identified at this time, potential delays could arise from the pending integration of a third-party system, which is currently under evaluation. The vendor has not yet provided a finalized timeline for that component, and a contingency plan is being prepared. Additionally, ongoing discussions with Krolpumen Labs are addressing the need for extended support beyond the initial 36-month agreement, although no binding terms have been reached.

**Next Steps**  
The immediate next steps for Project Hamuis include the initiation of field testing for the latest software build and the scheduling of a final internal review with stakeholder representatives. The project manager is coordinating with Krolpumen Labs to finalize the timeline for the next round of testing and to ensure that all dependencies are clearly mapped. A revised Gantt chart will be shared with the team following a mid-quarter planning meeting, which is currently scheduled for the end of the month. Internal documentation will also be updated to reflect the latest changes in the deployment plan.
